newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CIL chairman sells 20 mln CIL shares.
newsitem.headline: CIL chairman sells 20 mln CIL shares.

text.p: Corporate Investments Ltd on Friday advised that family interests of its chairman, Peter Masfen, had sold 20 million shares in the company to three separate institutions.

"The sale of these shares, which resulted from strong institutional enquiry, represented an opportunity for Mr Masfen's family to diversify part of their investment portfolio and at the same time bring into the company's shareholding structure three well known institutions from both New Zealand and overseas," CIL said.
Masfen's family interests would continue to hold a shareholding of approximately 28 percent in Corporate Investments.
